pricing_and_product_glamping_text_1: Get cosy in a glamping tent for you, yourself and you again. They are 5m in diameter! If you're sharing it with your partner, you'll get a double mattress with warm blankets and fluffy pillows. In case you want two singles, please let us know.
pricing_and_product_glamping_text_2: There's a lamp to give you light, and a plug for your electronics. Usually the tent will be inside our warehouse, or maybe there'll be availability in the land.
pricing_and_product_glamping_shared_text: Get cosy in a glamping tent for you, and two or three more folks. It's spacious and comfortable, don't worry - they are 5m in diameter. There's a lamp to give you light, and a plug for your electronics. Usually the tent will be inside our warehouse.
Compost toilets and showers are shared.
pricing_and_product_camping_text_1: Bring your own gear, or ask us if we can borrow you some. We recommend a camping mattress, a sleeping bag and a pillow. If it is winter, make sure your gear is warm and waterproof.
pricing_and_product_camping_text_2: Compost toilets and showers are shared.
pricing_and_product_van_parking_text_1: Przywieź swój dom na kółkach do wioski. Mamy na terenie płaskie miejsca z cieniem i dostępem do prądu. Idealne dla Twojego domu w podróży.

roles_page_description_1: Dołącz do naszej tętniącej życiem społeczności regeneracyjnej, gdzie praca i życie łączą się płynnie. Poszukujemy pasjonatów, którzy chcą przyczynić się do zrównoważonej przyszłości, żyjąc w harmonii z naturą i podobnie myślącymi ludźmi. Nasze role oferują więcej niż tylko zatrudnienie - zapewniają możliwość bycia częścią rosnącego ekosystemu, który ceni współpracę, naukę i zarządzanie środowiskiem.
roles_page_description_2: Niezależnie od tego, czy jesteś doświadczony w ogrodnictwie, budownictwie, gościnności, czy masz inne talenty do podzielenia się, witamy różnorodne perspektywy i umiejętności. W zamian doświadczysz życia w społeczności, nauczysz się praktyk regeneracyjnych i przyczynisz się do znaczących projektów, które mają wpływ.

ambassadors_signup_success: Your affiliate status is live. Put your first village on the map, or head to your dashboard to see how earnings are tracked.
ambassadors_faq_rewards_a: Joining grants you affiliate status. You earn a share of the revenue from every village attributed to you — the rates are set by us and visible in your dashboard.
ambassadors_faq_map_q: What is Tier 0 on the map?
ambassadors_faq_map_a: Listing a village on the map is free and commits them to nothing. It makes them discoverable to the whole network, and it’s where every Closer village starts.
ambassadors_faq_deploy_a: There is no setup fee. The village subscribes at €49/month with the first month free, then you or the owner requests deployment. Our team builds it out by hand for now — automation comes later.
ambassadors_profile_hint: Every Ambassador gets a public profile listing the villages they brought in.
villages_page_intro: Every land project on the Closer map — from a first pin to a village running its whole operation on the platform.
villages_empty: The directory is still filling up. Take a look at the map in the meantime.
villages_create_title: Add a village to the map
villages_create_intro: Drop a pin, tell their story, and check the fit. Listing is free and commits the village to nothing — you’ll be recorded as their ambassador.
villages_create_ambassador_required: Adding a village to the map is something Ambassadors do. Joining takes one click, it’s free, and you start earning on every village you bring in.
villages_deploy_pending: Deployment requested. Our team builds these by hand — you’ll hear back shortly.
villages_assign_ambassador_hint: Ambassadors you assign can set this village's verification status.
villages_action_error: That didn’t go through. Please try again.
deploy_queue_intro: Villages waiting for their Closer app. Approve the build, fulfil it via Procurement, then mark them live.
deploy_queue_empty: No villages are waiting on a deployment right now.
map_embed_intro: Embeddable regenerative map for network curators. Filterable Villages with roles, search, and verification badges — Phase 3 curator integration.
ambassadors_hero_footnote: Free to join · no quota · you keep earning for as long as your villages do
ambassadors_toolkit_body: Add villages to the map, follow them through to launch, and track what they earn you.
ambassadors_step_1_body: Add any land project you believe in — a pin, a story, a few photos of what they’re building. Listing is free and needs nothing from them.
ambassadors_step_2_body: Real land, people living on it, something already running, open to digital tools. The form scores this as you fill it in.
ambassadors_step_3_body: Introduce them, help them subscribe, and request their deployment. From then on you’re their first point of contact — and their revenue is attributed to you.
ambassadors_rewards_headline: You earn on everything they do
ambassadors_commercial_trial: Free, so they can try it for real
ambassadors_commercial_body: Bookings, events and content are all included from day one. After they subscribe, you or the village requests deployment and our team builds it out — usually within a few days.
ambassadors_closing_body: Join in one click, add it to the map in five minutes.

villages_form_onboarding_status_hint: Set by hand. Overrides the stage the fit check would otherwise pick.
villages_form_fit_intro: Five things tell us whether a village is ready for Closer. Nothing here blocks the listing — it just tells us where to focus.
